reading_copies.label: 1911 Cairo collection, Qatar National Library
reading_copies.note: Catalogue record only; the page viewer loaded neither in the session's browser nor in the owner's (2026-11-16).

sources.notes: Defines the scheme 'bina-35'. Other classical authors count the abwāb differently (charter §3). Authorship: the 1949 printing heads the text «للمولى ملا عبد الله الدنقزي [القرن التاسع الهجري]»; the catalogue record of the 1899 collection (QNL:00005293) names Muḥammad ibn Ḥamīd al-Kafawī. The attribution is therefore recorded as uncertain.
